title: Health regen with a cap
prompt: Health recovers at regen points per second but can never go above max_hp. Return the health after one frame.
signature: func solve(hp: float, regen: float, max_hp: float, delta: float) -> float:
starter:
func solve(hp: float, regen: float, max_hp: float, delta: float) -> float:
	return hp + regen * delta
hint: Add the regen, then cap it: min() with the maximum.
solution:
func solve(hp: float, regen: float, max_hp: float, delta: float) -> float:
	return min(hp + regen * delta, max_hp)
